results.title: Report: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope joining 76ers after Grizzlies buyout
results.description: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope is set to reunite with former teammate LeBron James after agreeing to a buyout with the Memphis Grizzlies and planning to sign a one-year deal with the Philadelphia 76ers, ESPN reported on Saturday.
